snippet.title: Ground of Aces - The World War II Base Builder - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get GROUND OF ACES now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2308690/Ground_of_Aces/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=youtubedescription

Take command of a remote military air base during World War II. Build your own airfield, manage iconic aircraft and oversee your crew’s well-being. Prepare them against air raids and send your pilots on dangerous missions. Survive and help your nation win the war!

Enlist on our website: https://www.groundofaces.com/
